summary: Sandbach United's preseason is in full swing as they prepare for the 26/27 campaign, which kicks off in just one week. The squad has been boosted with several new signings and one returning player, while the club has also unveiled three brand new kits for the upcoming season. In their recent friendly against St Helens, the Ramblers put in a solid performance but fell short, with their opponents taking their chances to secure the win.
